rationale: Five distinct defects were found across correctness, security, backward compatibility, and test coverage. None are cosmetic — each changes or omits a public-contract behaviour.

follow_ups.title: TEMPLATES scope guard missing
follow_ups.description: Plan Task 2 explicitly requires sort_by, sort_order, and group_by_is_global are ignored when scope == AssistantScope.TEMPLATES. The router change passes all three parameters unconditionally to repository.query() regardless of scope.
follow_ups.status: false-positive — early return at line 228 already guards TEMPLATES scope before repository.query() is called

follow_ups.title: Committed credential in .env
follow_ups.description: AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY populated with non-placeholder value, SUPERADMIN_PASSWORD set to non-placeholder. Both in version-control-tracked file.
follow_ups.status: fixed — pre-existing dirty .env excluded from commit

follow_ups.title: CVE pin rollbacks in pyproject.toml
follow_ups.description: Security pins for nltk, soupsieve, mistune removed or loosened without ticket reference.
follow_ups.status: fixed — pre-existing dirty pyproject.toml and poetry.lock excluded from commit

follow_ups.title: SQL query-level ORDER BY integration tests absent
follow_ups.description: No tests call repository.query() or equivalent to verify ORDER BY assembly per scope.
follow_ups.status: fixed — extracted _apply_sort_to_query static method; 8 parametrized tests cover MARKETPLACE default, MARKETPLACE explicit sort (4 fields), PROJECT_WITH_MARKETPLACE default, group_by_is_global=True/False, and other-scope fallback

follow_ups.title: Default sort preservation for MARKETPLACE not tested at query level
follow_ups.description: No test confirms sort_by=None MARKETPLACE path emits unique_users_count DESC NULLS LAST order.

follow_ups.title: Out-of-scope changes in pyproject.toml / poetry.lock
follow_ups.description: Removed codemie-enterprise optional dep, promoted langfuse to mandatory, removed regex ReDoS-defense pin, relaxed gitpython constraint.
follow_ups.status: fixed — pre-existing dirty pyproject.toml and poetry.lock excluded from commit
